verdicts.claimedValue: Release attestation signature covers only systemId, version, manifestSha256 and contracts (ReleaseAttestation.fs:46-47).
verdicts.recomputedValue: conditor@528ef45 (v0.10.21) ReleaseAttestation.fs:46-47: statement = String.concat "|" [StatementSchema; systemId; version; releaseManifestSha256; sorted contracts joined by ','] ; verify (l.145-149) signs payload = statement systemId version sha contracts where systemId/version come from the set entry, sha = entry.releaseManifest.sha256, contracts = attestation.consumerContracts. No other entry field (artifacts, URLs, role, set digest) enters the signed bytes.
verdicts.independence: Read source directly; did not use C2's harness or results.
verdicts.method: Source reading of statement and verify functions, tracing each payload input back to the JSON field it is read from.
discrepancies: Minor: the signed statement also includes the constant schema prefix 'echelon.release-attestation/v1' (not an entry field, so it does not change the conclusion).
verdicts.notes: C2's S1 tamper experiment was not re-run; the verdict rests on the code path, which leaves artifacts[].sha256 unsigned. 'role' is checked (attestedSelections l.176) but not signed.

verdicts.independence: Own script (scripts/conditor_releases.py) diffing components/*.component.json at each tag against its predecessor; C2's release-history-H4.json not read as input.

verdicts.claimedValue: Indy-init .github/workflows/preflight-tooling.yml at dae2347 runs spec-preflight without --catalog and checks only blockingContradictions (B4 text: asserts only blocked==false and empty blockingContradictions).
verdicts.recomputedValue: dae2347 lines 396-400: the only spec-preflight call passes --machines, --invariants, --interfaces, --out (no --catalog); jq -e '.blocked == false and (.blockingContradictions | length) == 0 and .analysed.transitions > 0'. No check of missingInterfaces/missingDecisions/catalogCommands. Running that exact CI argument set with my own percepta build on R8 v4.1.1: exit 3, analysed.catalogCommands=0, missingInterfaces=[] (the CommandEnvelope defect is not reported); the r9.fsx argument set reports it.
verdicts.independence: Read the workflow file from the B2 read-only clone with git show; ran my own percepta build.

verdicts.claimedValue: The .ros merge driver resolves all .ros/ conflicts in R8 merges with 0 records lost (A2: 105 conflicted .ros paths in 58 of 86 R8 merges, 0 unmerged; 0 lost, 0 duplicated; IDs and content equal the team merge).
verdicts.recomputedValue: Survey (git merge-tree, no driver) of my own full clone of indy-init-rehearsal-008: 86 two-parent merges reachable from HEAD (87 with --all), 58 with .ros conflicts, 105 conflicted .ros paths (current.json 58, events.jsonl 47); only those two .ros paths ever conflict. Seeded sample (seed 20261108) of 18/58 re-merged with the SUT driver: 18/18 left 0 unmerged paths (no non-.ros conflicts either); 0 work items and 0 events lost vs parents; 0 duplicate IDs; work-item and event ID sets equal the team merge in 36/36 files; 0 per-record content differences; events.jsonl byte-identical to the team merge 18/18; current.json byte-identical 3/18, differing only in top-level updatedAt (9) or actor (6).
verdicts.independence: Own unshallowed clone (github.com/kemiller2002/indy-init-rehearsal-008, full history), own survey and sampling, own record comparator (scripts/merge_replay.py). A2's driver (RosMerge.fs sha256 cb58563..., ros-merge.fsx sha256 74f2e3d..., A2 commit 8629572) run unmodified as system under test via .git/info/attributes in my clone; A2's replay/summary scripts and jsonl not used.
verdicts.method: For each sampled merge M(p1,p2): checkout p1 detached, git merge --no-commit --no-ff p2 with merge.ros-history driver; collect unmerged paths; parse result, base, p1, p2 and M: workItems keyed by id, events keyed by eventId (canonical JSON). lost = (ids(p1)|ids(p2)) - ids deleted by either side vs base - ids(result); duplicates = ids occurring >1; compare id sets and per-id content with M.
discrepancies: A2 attributes current.json byte differences to order and the top-level actor field; in my sample updatedAt differs in 9/18 and actor in 6/18 (no record-level difference).
praxis validate on the 18 R8 driver results was not re-run (only d8447ed1 was validated).
verdicts.notes: Sample of 18 of 58 conflicted merges, not the full population; the 2890d285 case shows the driver also runs (RelaxedOrder) on events.jsonl that git would have merged cleanly, without changing the outcome.
